meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

copy.tagline: 引导创建首个智能体并配置消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并测试第一个智能体机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Guide through creating the first agent and configuring messaging channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly set up and test your first agent bot.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你完成创建第一个 NanoClaw agent 的全过程：选择渠道、提供你的用户信息、解析 DM 平台 ID、运行初始化脚本，并发送欢迎 DM 给你确认。
howto.when: 在渠道凭证已配置且服务运行后，当你要求创建第一个 NanoClaw agent 时触发。

say.text: 请帮我创建第一个 NanoClaw agent。
say.note: Claude 开始引导选择渠道和输入身份信息。

say.text: 初始化 Discord 渠道的第一个 agent。
say.note: 指定渠道类型，流程针对性调整。

say.text: 我的 Telegram 用户 ID 是 12345，请开始设置。
say.note: 直接提供信息可加速流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will walk you through creating the first NanoClaw agent: choose a channel, provide your user info, resolve the DM platform ID, run the init script, and send a welcome DM for confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create the first NanoClaw agent, after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

say_en.text: Please help me create the first NanoClaw agent.
Initialize the first agent for Discord.
say_en.note: Specify the channel to tailor the flow.

say_en.text: My Telegram user ID is 12345, start the setup.
say_en.note: Providing info upfront speeds up the process.
